## Executive Summary
Giorgio Di Cristofalo is a Software Engineer specializing in distributed web architectures, operational process automation, and practical applied artificial intelligence. He combines academic rigor (M.Sc. in Computer Engineering, 110/110 Summa Cum Laude, research on adversarial NLP defenses) with production engineering experience on safety-critical aviation systems (ENAV Group). He designs and deploys custom software platforms, deterministic optimization solvers (Google OR-Tools), and asynchronous AI streaming pipelines.

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Custom Web Platforms & MVP Development
End-to-end design and implementation of production-grade web applications from scratch: relational database modeling, decoupled asynchronous backends, modern responsive frontends, authentication, and payment integrations. Focus on high performance, clean interfaces, and fast time-to-market without agency overhead.

### 2. Operational Process Automation & Applied AI
Engineering resilient automation pipelines to eliminate manual data entry and operational bottlenecks between ERPs, CRMs, WhatsApp, PDFs, and email. Implementation of pragmatic AI: mathematical constraint optimization (OR-Tools CP-SAT), fast vector calculations (<30ms kNN), and asynchronous streaming agent pipelines (Celery, Redis Pub/Sub, Server-Sent Events) that run reliably 24/7.

---

## Engineering Philosophy: Pragmatic AI vs Fragile Hype
Giorgio prioritizes deterministic algorithms and mathematical solvers where safety, correctness, and speed are mandatory, reserving Large Language Models for unstructured reasoning and synthesis. 
- Uses **Google OR-Tools CP-SAT** for combinatorial and spatial problems (zero hallucinations, 100% hard constraint enforcement).
- Uses **PostgreSQL vector math / kNN** for ultra-low latency (<30ms) nutritional or product recommendations directly in SQL.
- Uses **Asynchronous Event-Driven Architectures** (Celery + Redis Pub/Sub + SSE) for LLM interactions to avoid blocking web workers.

---

## Technical Articles & Deep Dives
- **Why Operations Research Beats LLMs (Google OR-Tools)**: https://giorgiodicristofalo.com/articles/or-tools-vs-llm (English: https://giorgiodicristofalo.com/en/articles/or-tools-vs-llm)
  - Detailed technical analysis on 2D disjoint interval bin packing, CP-SAT solver implementation in Python, and mathematical constraint guarantees versus LLM hallucinations in spatial systems.

## Selected Production Projects & Architecture Case Studies

### 1. NutriFit — Agentic Nutrition Platform
- **URL**: https://giorgiodicristofalo.com/projects/nutrifit
- **Live Demo**: https://www.nutrifitai.it/
- **Summary**: An agentic SaaS platform for nutritionists and athletic trainers. Complex plan generation triggers Celery workers that query Google Gemini with strictly typed JSON schemas, streaming tokens via Redis Pub/Sub and Server-Sent Events (SSE) to the browser without blocking web threads. A PostgreSQL kNN vector engine calculates instant (<30ms) dietary swaps based on Euclidean macronutrient distance.
- **Stack**: Python 3.12, Django 5, DRF, Celery, Redis Pub/Sub, PostgreSQL, Google Gemini API, Stripe, Server-Sent Events.

### 2. Harbor Manager — Marina Spatial Berth Optimization
- **URL**: https://giorgiodicristofalo.com/projects/harbor-manager
- **Summary**: AI marina berth allocation platform. Formulates boat placement as a 2D Bin Packing Constraint Satisfaction problem solved using Google OR-Tools CP-SAT. Converts PostGIS coordinates into a normalized cartesian grid, enforcing hard physical constraints (draft depth, channel clearance, bow/stern safety margins) and recovering +22% dock capacity with zero hallucinations.
- **Stack**: Python, Flask, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Google OR-Tools, Celery, Redis, Angular 21, Leaflet.

### 3. Central Parking — Gate Logistics & WhatsApp Automation
- **URL**: https://giorgiodicristofalo.com/projects/central-parking
- **Live Demo**: https://parking-manager-fe.vercel.app/
- **Summary**: High-volume cruise parking reservation and gate check-in system in active production. Generates dynamic vector PDF vouchers with encrypted QR codes. Gate operators scan vehicles on mobile cameras in <0.5s. Integrates WhatsApp Cloud API for automated dispatch of tickets to travelers.
- **Stack**: Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, JWT, WhatsApp Cloud API, ReportLab, Angular 17, Tailwind CSS.

### 4. ESN Buddy Program — Algorithmic Student Matching
- **URL**: https://giorgiodicristofalo.com/projects/esn-buddy-program
- **Live Demo**: https://esn-buddy-program.vercel.app/
- **Summary**: Automated mentor matching platform pairing incoming international Erasmus students with local buddies. Features a multi-criteria weighted scoring algorithm, automated GDPR batch data deletion, and dynamic notification dispatch.
- **Stack**: Python, Flask, PostgreSQL, Jinja2, Werkzeug, Excel Automation, GDPR Engine.

### 5. MatchBandiGara — Public Tender Qualification Engine
- **URL**: https://giorgiodicristofalo.com/projects/match-bandi-gara
- **Summary**: Automated public procurement ingestion and multi-level scoring system evaluating enterprise qualifications and tender criteria, accelerating qualification speed 10x.
- **Stack**: Python, Flask, PostgreSQL, JWT, Asynchronous Tasks.

### 6. Network Tester Interface — Bare Metal Hardware Diagnostics
- **URL**: https://giorgiodicristofalo.com/projects/network-tester
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Horghe20/EthernetTester
- **Summary**: Handheld standalone network diagnostic unit built from scratch on Arduino. Interfaces directly with ENC28J60 Ethernet controller over hardware SPI bus and low-latency resistive TFT touchscreen. Executes DHCP leases, ICMP pinging, and hardware register telemetry within <1.8 KB SRAM.
- **Stack**: C/C++, Arduino, SPI Protocol, ENC28J60 Ethernet, ICMP.
